category: Application Library examples: Particle Tracing Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Particle Tracing Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Brownian Motion [Particle Tracing Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Particle Tracing Module (Verification Examples): Brownian Motion. Physics interfaces: Particle Tracing for Fluid Flow (fpt), Transport of Diluted Species (tds). Study steps: Parametric Sweep, Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
